dct_description_sm: This is a set of 17 hydrometeorological datasets (built from a subset of 52 unique time series) for benchmarking streamflow and/or flood prediction methods. The datasets each contain hourly time series of weather and river variables for locations within the Grand River watershed in Ontario, Canada.
